<thought>To find a suitable one‑step retrosynthetic transformation, I will look for a Diels‑Alder disconnection. In the forward Diels‑Alder reaction two C=C double bonds are converted into two new C‑C single bonds, so the reaction breaks C‑C double bonds and forms C‑C single bonds (bond type “6‑6”). I will search the template catalog for templates that break a C‑C double bond and form a C‑C single bond.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>

  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
